What do your bone names actually mean? 🦴
10 bones, decoded on a 3D skeleton: Latin and Greek meanings in 26 seconds.

Mandible – from Latin 'to chew'
Clavicle – 'little key'
Sternum – Greek 'chest'
Vertebra – from 'to turn'
Humerus – 'shoulder'
Radius – 'spoke' · Ulna – 'elbow'
Phalanges – 'lines of soldiers'
Pelvis – 'basin'
Femur – 'thigh'
Tibia – 'flute' · Fibula – 'brooch pin'

Which one surprised you? Save this for your next anatomy exam.
